# JAAD benchmarks

Results are comparable only within the same protocol section. A code link is not an independent reproduction.

## WACV 2021 JAAD_all PCPA attention comparison

<a id="jaad-all-wacv2021-pcpa"></a>

**Task:** `behavior_prediction` (original: pedestrian crossing action prediction)  
**Dataset release:** `jaad_2_0` �� **Annotation version:** `JAAD_2.0`  
**Target:** `crossing_action` �� **Split:** WACV 2021 JAAD_all: 177 train / 29 validation / 117 test video clips

### Comparison setting

| Dimension | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sample selection | 323 high-visibility clips after excluding 23 lower-resolution/adverse-weather/night clips; JAAD_all includes additional bystander pedestrians; 0.8 sequence overlap, 16 observed frames and 30�C60-frame time-to-event. |
| Inputs | rgb, trajectory, vehicle_telemetry; Only the 16-frame observed pedestrian segment; no post-event frames supplied. |
| Representation | RGB context, pedestrian bounding boxes and qualitative JAAD ego-vehicle speed labels; author model also extracts pose from RGB. |
| Observation window | 16 frames (last observed frame) |
| Anticipation gap | 30�C60 frames (crossing event start) |
| Prediction horizon | not applicable |
| Training policy | external_data: allowed, pretraining: allowed, extra_supervision: allowed, ensemble: forbidden |
| Evaluation | Binary crossing classification on JAAD_all samples.; Overall test statistic in JAAD_all Table 3 column. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Definition | Direction | Unit | Subset | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accuracy` | Fraction of correctly classified crossing and non-crossing samples. | higher | ratio | JAAD_all | [paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/WACV2021/papers/Kotseruba_Benchmark_for_Evaluating_Pedestrian_Action_Prediction_WACV_2021_paper.pdf) |

| Inputs | rgb; Only RGB frames up to the 30�C60-frame time-to-event cutoff. |
